Critique welcomed as always, I've been toying with some of the ideas
in my head and then noticed that Antonio D'Erlette has pot. :) I did
shamelessly netlist a few decks together for ideas, so credits to the
TWDA and the usual suspects for some of the cards that turned up.

Deck Name : Empowered Little Suckers
Author : Dave "Shockwave" Knowles
Description : Take one Cryptic Mission deck. Take one Nephandus deck.
Notice new card allows you to basically Cryptic Mission, with an untap
AND gives you [pot].

Or to put it another way:
"I just want to a Nephandus bleed for 2, get blocked and then rip
someones arms off."

Messages.Author: Chris Berger
Messages.Body:
On Feb 10, 5:24 am, Shockwave <d_knowles...@hotmail.com> wrote:
> Critique welcomed as always, I've been toying with some of the ideas
> in my head and then noticed that Antonio D'Erlette has pot. :) I did
> shamelessly netlist a few decks together for ideas, so credits to the
> TWDA and the usual suspects for some of the cards that turned up.
>
> Deck Name : Empowered Little Suckers
> Author : Dave "Shockwave" Knowles
> Description : Take one Cryptic Mission deck. Take one Nephandus deck.
> Notice new card allows you to basically Cryptic Mission, with an untap
> AND gives you [pot].
>
> Or to put it another way:
> "I just want to a Nephandus bleed for 2, get blocked and then rip
> someones arms off."
>

I like it in theory, but I think you're going to have a lot of
"Nephandus uses Leech" "I block the Leech and take a damage or two in
combat" "okay, now I have a bunch of potence cards in my hand that I
can't use." I think the only way to get the Leech through is to
somehow use Cloak the Gathering and Veil the Legions (not really an
option for this deck), or play with so many Leeches in the deck that
you don't have room for much else and/or just choke on them at other
times. Not to mention that difficultly of actually getting more than
like 2 or 3 Leeches for meatspace deck construction.

I really wish there was an action modifier to give allies stealth. It
makes sense, something like "Daylight Machinations" or "Afternoon
Appointment" - Vampires get -1 intercept when attempting to block this
action.

Another option, which I'm afraid would turn out to be terrible, but
maybe worth thinking about, would be Magic of the Smith some Deer
Rifles or Sniper Rifles (a long with some other random, good
equipment) to complement the Bowl, and throw in Suppressing Fire.

Messages.Author: Shockwave
Messages.Body:
> Another option, which I'm afraid would turn out to be terrible, but
> maybe worth thinking about, would be Magic of the Smith some Deer
> Rifles or Sniper Rifles (a long with some other random, good
> equipment) to complement the Bowl, and throw in Suppressing Fire.

Ah, I've already tossed out the Bowl (No minions with AUS, what was I
thinking?) and tweaked the combat slightly here:
http://www.zen36316.zen.co.uk/vtes/empowered_leeches.html

That said, I agree. I'm mildly worried about jamming on pot, the
Vampires can all play it too but there's not a vast amount of it
anyway. Suppressing Fire would be lovely (considered Zip Guns that I
just don't fire!) but I figured if they block the Leech, I still get
to hit most people a little bit, and a Nephandus losing an Action
isn't the end of the world.

The addition of the 2* Graverobbing were purely for 'What was I
thinking?!' after conversations in #vtes on IRC. :)
